versions.content: The function EthSwt_GetPortSignalQuality shall obtain the signal quality by calling the function EthTrcv_GetPhySignalQuality of the referenced Ethernet Transceiver Driver. If the current signal quality is not available, the signal quality shall be set to 0xFFFFFFFF .
